apps.name: Widget for Messages Sideloaded
apps.subtitle: Messages widgets for iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription: Display selected message conversations in home screen widgets. The sideloaded edition uses local device data and a companion Shortcut for message intake. See the app guide for setup and platform-specific behavior: https://ibanks.craft.me/Es3CS1kds2eyE6

versions.localizedDescription: Sideloaded edition with widget sizes unlocked. Requires setup using the companion Shortcut. iOS/iPadOS package; visionOS package is available on the GitHub release page.

privacy.NSContactsUsageDescription: Widget for Messages needs access to your contacts to identify message senders and organize conversations using contact groups you create. This helps display contact names and photos in your message widgets.
privacy.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: Widget for Messages Sideloaded can send you notifications about new messages to help you stay updated. You can customize notification settings for each conversation.

apps.name: Shortcuts Time Machine
apps.subtitle: Back up and inspect Apple Shortcuts
apps.localizedDescription: Keep versioned backups of your Apple Shortcuts, compare versions, inspect actions, and export readable action details. See the app guide for setup and feature details: https://ibanks.craft.me/fyLKg0ThsOoT5z

versions.localizedDescription: Existing sideloaded build 51. Includes readable action list exports and clear separators between multiple Shortcuts.

privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Save shortcut icons to your Photos library when you choose Save to Photos.

apps.name: Automation Control
apps.subtitle: Manage your Shortcuts automations
apps.localizedDescription: Create control items and conditions for Apple Shortcuts automations. Before replacing an App Store or TestFlight installation, export a .ctrl backup to Files outside the app. The sideloaded build may use different Apple service entitlements. App guide: https://ibanks.craft.me/6kbyyNVhWXjawv Sideloading options: https://ibanks.craft.me/tsVhkxyAO5ZyQM

versions.localizedDescription: Build 12 improves backup-file selection and validates a backup before Clear All and Import. Device testing of backup import is still pending. Back up existing data before changing installation.

privacy.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Automation Control reads event names from your calendars to evaluate the calendar conditions you configure.
privacy.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Automation Control needs access to your calendar to check event names for automation conditions.
privacy.NSFileProviderPresenceUsageDescription: We need access to your documents to select Controller and Scheduler images.
privacy.NSFocusStatusUsageDescription: Focus mode status is used to trigger automations based on your Focus settings.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: This app needs access to your local network to be used as a automation condition in the Automation Control app.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: location access allows automations to trigger based on your location even when the app is not active.
privacy.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: This app needs access to your location to set automation conditions.
privacy.NSLocationUsageDescription: This app needs access to your location to set automation conditions.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is used to trigger automation based on your current location.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access is needed for Siri voice commands to control your automation items.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: Automation Control needs Motion & Fitness access to check device motion conditions such as walking, running, cycling, and driving.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo access is needed to allow you to customize automation items with images.
privacy.NSSiriUsageDescription: Allow Automation Control to work with Siri and Shortcuts
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Speech recognition is used to understand your voice commands for controlling automation items.
privacy.NSWeatherKitUsageDescription: This app requires access to your location to set automation conditions based on weather.
